messages:
Riley: quick copy question for the 'Pause autoscaling' confirmation modal — current headline says: `Pause autoscaling?` and the body: `Your dedicated pool will stop scaling up automatically. You can still manually resize.`
Riley: people on support said customers get nervous about 'stop scaling' and interpret it as "capacity will drop" which is not true.
Priya: yeah i saw a ticket where someone thought their running jobs would be killed. we should be explicit. maybe: 'Pausing autoscaling won't terminate existing instances; it only prevents automatic scale-ups.'
Mark: that's pretty long for a modal body. users skim. could we do a short sentence + inline hint? e.g. header: 'Pause autoscaling', body: 'This stops automatic scale-ups. Existing instances remain running.'
Asha: short + explicit sounds good. tiny accessibility note: avoid passive voice when possible for clarity in screen reader flow. also ensure the modal close button and confirm button have distinct text.
Riley: good call on button text. current buttons: 'Cancel' and 'Pause'. support suggested 'Pause autoscale' instead of 'Pause' so there's no ambiguity in activity logs or keyboard announcements.
Priya: agree — 'Pause autoscale' reads better when VoiceOver reads the action. also add aria-describedby linking to the explanation paragraph.
Mark: we should warn about any effect on SLA or burst capacity. is there any functional change beyond scale-ups?
Asha: no change to existing instances or scheduled jobs. max burst capacity remains unless you also disable bursts. might be worth adding a one-line footer: 'You can re-enable autoscaling anytime from the pool settings.'
Riley: proposed final copy: header: 'Pause autoscaling', body: 'Stops automatic scale-ups. Existing instances and running jobs are not affected.', footer: 'You can re-enable autoscaling anytime from the pool settings.' buttons: ['Cancel', 'Pause autoscale']
Priya: lgtm. add a short test: with screen reader ensure announce says 'Pause autoscaling dialog' and that confirm button reads 'Pause autoscale'.
i18n-bot: note: string keys created: `pool.pause_modal.title`, `pool.pause_modal.body`, `pool.pause_modal.footer`, `pool.pause_modal.confirm` — please add context notes for translators: avoid literal machine translations for 'scale-ups' (provide example).
Mark: thanks bot. can we shorten body for mobile? maybe 'Stops automatic scale-ups. Running instances stay active.'
Asha: mobile OK as long as aria-describedby still points to the full explanation in the DOM (visually truncated but available to screen readers).
Riley: i'll push a tiny copy PR with these strings + accessibility checklist. assigning to @Priya for review.
Priya: taking it. :thumbsup:
Riley: thanks all!
